summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding a private placement under Regulation S, agreeing to sell 20M shares of common stock at $0.60 per share for gross proceeds of ~$12M to non-U.S. accredited investors. No commissions were paid; the shares represent less than 20% of outstanding common stock. The company granted registration rights, requiring a resale registration statement filed within 90 days and declared effective within 75 days of filing. While this is not a return of capital to existing shareholders, it is an equity capital raise (issuer selling shares) that increases the float and dilutes existing holders, aligning most closely with the 'Capital Returns' category as an issuance event. Watch for potential dilution impact and stock price reaction.
